data.name: Shrivatsa
data.gender_notes: Shrivatsa is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shrivatsa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shrivatsa' which means 'God's Mark'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is believed to have a sacred mark named Shrivatsa on his chest. This mark is considered a symbol of divine grace and blessings. The name Shrivatsa carries the meaning “God's Mark” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shrivatsa usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mark and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shrivatsa is believed to bestow divine blessings and prosperity on the bearer. It is a symbol of grace, power, and protection.
data.etymology: Shrivatsa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Mark.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shrivatsa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
